Hey there! I could use a hand with an order I placed recently. I got a bit carried away with the whole work-from-home vibe and ordered some home office stuff along with hiking gear—thought I’d be working remotely from Seattle and hitting the trails. But now my company’s calling everyone back to the office (classic, right?). 

Is there any way I can return just the office items and keep the hiking stuff? I honestly can’t remember exactly what I ordered for the office, though. Also, I’d love to know how much I’d get back if that’s possible, and I’d want the refund to go back to my original payment method. If that’s not doable, maybe we can just change the shipping address to my NYC place instead?

Oh, I actually don’t have an email tied to the order—don’t ask, it’s a long story involving a typo and a cat walking across my keyboard. But I can give you my name and zip code! It’s Noah Patel, and the zip is 10108.

Honestly, my memory’s about as reliable as my Wi-Fi during a thunderstorm—I can’t remember the order date at all. If you could list out the items from my recent orders, I’ll do my best to pick out the office stuff from the lineup!

Thanks for pulling that up! Okay, so the “office squad” would be the Mechanical Keyboard, Headphones, and Office Chair. The Cycling Helmet and Hiking Boots are definitely for my outdoor adventures—those I want to keep!

Let’s see if we can return just those three office items. If that’s possible, I’d love to know how much I’ll get back, and please send the refund to my original payment method. If it turns out I can’t do a partial return, just let me know and we’ll switch gears to updating the shipping address to my NYC place.

Let’s go with option one—please remove the Mechanical Keyboard, Headphones, and Office Chair from the order. I’ll stick with the hiking boots and cycling helmet (gotta keep my outdoor dreams alive, even if my office dreams are on hold).

Once you’ve done that, could you let me know how much I’ll be getting back? And just to confirm, the refund will go back to my original payment method, right?

Yes, please go ahead and remove the Mechanical Keyboard, Headphones, and Office Chair from my order and refund the amount to my PayPal. I’m ready to commit—no more last-minute changes from me (famous last words, right?). Let’s do it!

Alright, looks like my plan to Marie Kondo my order just hit a snag! Let’s go with plan B—please update the shipping address to my NYC place instead. That way, I can just return the office items once they arrive (and maybe use the box as a makeshift standing desk in the meantime).

Let me know what info you need from me to update the address!

That’s the one! 224 Elm Street, Suite 491, New York, NY 10108—sounds like home (and a lot of takeout menus). Please go ahead and update the shipping address to that location. Thanks for helping me navigate this little work-from-home rollercoaster!
Awesome, thanks for sorting that out! I’ll keep an eye out for the delivery—and maybe start practicing my “returning unwanted office gear” routine. Appreciate your help today! That’s all I needed.
Thanks! I’ll try to survive the office jungle and the real one. Have a good one! ###STOP###
